acceptance: A red-first test: an origin commit lands outside the lane after the audit; the lane ship fast-forwards local main, rebinds, and pushes, and the cycle ships
A test: a local main that diverged from origin is still refused and is not reset or force-pushed
A test: a GIT_PUSH_REJECTED with local main a strict ancestor of the origin ref takes the rebind path
The fast-forward runs only while the ship window lease is held
fix: Inside the ship window (enterShipWindow, go/internal/phases/ship/shipwindow_lease.go), before the fleet ff-merge and before a rebind, fetch origin main and fast-forward the local main when it is a strict ancestor of origin/main, with the same rules as the wave-boundary sync (tracked dirt only from inbox stamps; diverged main stays a halt). The rebind then rebases onto the synced main. A GIT_PUSH_REJECTED whose local main is a strict ancestor of the origin ref routes to the rebind path, not to a terminal FAIL. Emit one signal when the ship fast-forwards local main (old, new, cycle).
summary: On 2026-11-20 the console landed main-red fix PR #1600 mid-wave through `evolve integration batch --main-red-fix`, which the main-red stop protocol calls for. integration.GitMain.FastForward (go/internal/integration/gitmain.go:25-33) pushes the tip to origin only, so origin/main went to 93775a479 and the runtime's local main stayed at aa909f868. The loop syncs local main from origin only between iterations (syncMainFromOriginAtWaveBoundary, called from loopBatchCoordinator.probeSyncAndPublish, go/cmd/evolve/cmd_loop_window.go:91), and evolve sync-main refuses while the run lease is live (go/cmd/evolve/cmd_syncmain.go). Cycle 2565 passed audit, got SHIP_GIT_FLEET_REBASE_NEEDED at 14:31Z, recovered by rebind onto the local main, and then failed with GIT_PUSH_REJECTED at 15:10Z: head a06497b32 (parent aa909f868) does not descend from origin_ref 93775a479 (.evolve/runs/cycle-2565/ship-error.json, repair_outcome needs-reaudit). Each later lane ship in the wave would fail the same way. The console healed it once with a fast-forward of local main while the ship window queue was empty.
title: a mid-wave integration landing strands every lane ship, because the ship rebases onto a local main that only the wave boundary syncs
